Q.5(a) Explain maximum likelihood estimation with suitable example. [2] 1,2 2
Q.5(b) Consider the following two hypothesis.
(a) A particular brick is suitable for building material.
(b) Brick is not suitable for building material.
From the past data it is considered that 0.1 bricks are not suitable for building material.
The brick strength test is the indicator for suitability of bricks and the test shows 99% of
correct  positive  result  and  99.5%  of  correct  negative  results.  Determine  the  posterior
probability of new brick to be suitable for building material along with positive test result.
